def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Compact expression for OTFT drain current model for p-channel Org2."""
    half_sqrt_vds = 0.5 * np.sqrt(drain_voltage_abs)
    gate_voltage_part = np.power(gate_voltage_abs, parameters[1])
    offset = parameters[0] + parameters[2] * gate_voltage_part
    return parameters[3] * offset + half_sqrt_vds
